column1: # JSP document counters (.jspx, tag files in XML syntax .tagx), for a rule with the prompt
# file-body-view: the counters of jsp-facts, its [ignore] line included, which count the directive
# directives of a page. A JSP document is XML: the container never sends its XML comments, so the
# [ignore] line here blanks them too (one never closed runs to the end of the file), and a
# <jsp:scriptlet> or an EL expression in one does not count. A page (.jsp) keeps its HTML comments,
# whose server code still runs: it takes jsp-facts. ViewFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
